# Ambiente Frankfurt

> > Ambiente is the world's leading consumer goods trade fair held annually in Frankfurt am Main, showcasing innovations in Dining, Living, Giving, HoReCa, and Hospitality Interiors.

Organized by Messe Frankfurt, Ambiente serves as the premier international platform for the consumer goods industry, connecting manufacturers, retailers, and hospitality professionals across sectors including interior design, tableware, home textiles, gifts, and contract business.
